_comment: Drives test/klippy/delta.test under the simavr bridge in tick_mode. The simavr tick-socket lockstep (synchronous host-UART shuttle per RunFor) runs klippy and the bridge on one simulated clock, so delta G28 + a short move complete deterministically regardless of host CPU load (validated 15/15). auto_trsync_trigger_ticks fires each tower's endstop on G28 after 100 step edges so homing completes; analog_in_default keeps thermistor reads in-range so the extruder/heater_bed config stays out of min/max-temp shutdown.
